svg.title: Choose a tool for the job in front of you
svg.desc: A useful comparison starts with the work and the evidence you can check. Job. Decide whether you need writing, research, code or another output. Sources. Locate the document, spreadsheet or project the tool would need. Test. Try a small example and compare the result with the source.
